deals.name: Red Heat Tavern
deals.deal: Advertised happy hour Mon–Fri 3–6pm: $2 off drafts, $7 house wine, sangria, mule, margarita, cosmo, lemon drop and well drinks; bar bites $5–$8 (wings, tenders, cauliflower, dip trio).

deals.name: BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse
deals.deal: Posted happy hour all day Sunday, Mon–Fri 3–7pm, and Mon–Thu 9pm–close: $4 domestic bottles and chips & dips, $5 signature beers and dark-horse wines, $6 brewhouse margarita and call drinks, $7 select apps and personal deep-dish pizza.

deals.name: Dave & Buster's Manchester
deals.deal: Chain happy hour advertised Mon–Fri 4–7pm in the bar: $5 house margarita, house wine, Long Island iced tea and 22 oz domestic drafts, with a late-night $5 window after.

shop.name: Big Y
